evaluation_policies.score_dimensions: report raw scientific/grounding/consistency criterion scores on a common scale; weighted contributions are not directly comparable
evaluation_policies.missing_evidence_or_ground_truth: not_evaluated/unverified; do not silently turn judge errors or missing ground truth into zero
evaluation_policies.empty_final_answer: zero for written-answer component when genuinely absent; artifact task fulfillment may still be inspected
evaluation_policies.partial_component_metrics: do not present entity/set/numerical-only scores as complete compound-task fulfillment
evaluation_policies.tool_metrics: separate from final-answer/artifact scores; respect explicit task-specific exceptions
evaluation_policies.implementation_status: metric/check names are configuration placeholders unless a concrete validator is implemented and invoked
evaluation_policies.check_execution_modes: The legacy deterministic_checks container includes semantic and mixed requirements. Only validation_mode=deterministic is purely deterministic; conditional_deterministic needs resolved accepted constraints; semantic_judgment needs AAJ/rubric evidence-based assessment. This metadata does not implement a runner.
evaluation_policies.mapping_status_vs_readiness: requires_additional_evaluation is a legacy flag also used for pending GT/implementation, not a reliable missing-component count. Determine mapping gaps from coverage_status/pending_component_proposal; report implementation and execution readiness separately.
evaluation_policies.deterministic_score_reporting: Report factual checks and task components separately. Precision/recall/F1/exact-set-match are correlated views, not independent weighted achievements. Exact/alias/fuzzy identity matches are alternatives. Aggregate only under explicit component weights and common normalization; missing GT/infrastructure failures are not zeros.
evaluation_policies.grounding_evidence: Use saved tool responses and candidate-bound AAJ inspection observations. Missing material evidence yields unverified/null grounding; other criteria remain independently scoreable. No complete weighted total until all criteria are scored. New generation can archive artifacts with --archive-evidence; existing missing data is not reconstructed.

scalar_numerical_scoring.field_aggregation: mean over all required GT fields; missing, invalid and unparseable predictions receive zero
scalar_numerical_scoring.quantity_policy: Same metric for every ordinary scalar, including geodetic distance; task accuracy is specified only through field tolerances. GT source verification, derivation and unit normalization are separate.
scalar_numerical_scoring.configuration: numerical_field_tolerances in task strategy or field_tolerances in GT; canonical parameters abs_tol, rel_tol, floor_scale. No new tolerance values inferred automatically.
scalar_numerical_scoring.compatibility: Existing band/coordinate presets and tolerance aliases preserved; legacy method names remain. Mean Hit@tol and NumScore are stored explicitly; normalized error is an error diagnostic, not the NumScore itself.
